RTAE + PRIA DOCK · CONCEPT

Introducing RTAE.

Real-Time Adaptation Engine

RTAE bachche ke expressions, nazar, body language, awaaz aur jawab dene mein lagne wale time ko uske answers ke saath dekhega. RTAE camera se bachche ka heart rate bhi check karta hai. Yeh sab milkar samajhne mein madad karenge ki bachcha atka hai, thaka hai, ya tension mein hai.

Isse padhai kaise badlegi? Agar concept samajh nahi aaya, toh AI naye example se samjhayega. Zyada time chahiye, toh dheere, step by step padhayega. Thakaan ho, toh break suggest karega.

DEKHIYE RTAE KYA CAPTURE KAREGA

Chehre se awaaz tak.
Har signal ka padhai se kya rishta hai?

Camera, microphone aur learning activity se milne wale signals ko RTAE saath samjhega—taaki bachche ki zaroorat ke hisaab se padhaya ja sake.

Ek option chuniye: kya capture hoga aur padhai mein kaise madad milegi.

Chehra kya keh raha hai?
Nazar kahan jaa rahi hai?

Kya dekhega: Expressions, blink patterns aur nazar ki direction mein badlav.

Padhai mein fayda: Inhe answers aur bachche ke feedback se jodkar engagement aur emotional state samajhne ki koshish karega. Uljhan ke sanket hon toh AI teacher doosra example samjha sakega.

Nazar hatna, apne aap mein dhyaan hatne ka proof nahi hai.

Baithne ke tareeke mein
kya badal raha hai?

Kya dekhega: Sir, kandhon aur upper-body ki position aur movement.

Padhai mein fayda: Posture badalne ke saath jawaab bhi dheere aane lagen, toh RTAE thakaan ki possibility check karega. Bachche se poochhkar pace kam karne ya break ki recommendation de sakega.

Ek posture se thakaan ya stress tay nahi hoga.

Jawaab dete waqt awaaz
aur rukne ka pattern kaisa hai?

Kya sunega: Awaaz ka utaar-chadhaav, bolne ki speed aur beech ke pauses.

Padhai mein fayda: Jawaab shuru karne ka waqt aur uski accuracy bhi saath dekhega. Agar bachche ko sochne ya samjhane mein mushkil ho, toh AI teacher zyada waqt ya chhota hint de sakega.

Accent ya dheere bolna, kam samajh ka label nahi banega.

Camera se bachche ka
heart rate check hota hai.

Kaise: RTAE face video mein skin se reflect hone wali light ke chhote badlav se heart rate ka estimate nikaalta hai.

Padhai mein fayda: Reliable pulse cues ko task, movement aur bachche ke feedback ke saath dekhega. Isse stress ke possible sanketon ko context mil sakta hai; uske baad support ya break ki zaroorat check hogi.

Tez dhadkan = stress, aisa seedha conclusion nahi hoga.

In observations se bachche ko kaise samjhega?

  1. 01

    Signal bharosemand hai?

    Pehle light, movement, audio noise aur data quality check hogi. Unreliable signal se confident reading nahi banegi.

  2. 02

    Is bachche ke liye kya badla?

    Current signals ko bachche ke apne usual patterns—uske baseline—aur sawaal ki difficulty se compare karega.

  3. 03

    Madad se farq pada?

    RTAE apni understanding AI team tak pahunchayega. Agle answer aur bachche ke feedback se check hoga ki madad sahi thi.

Planned design · Consent, device support and validation required. Stress and mood are estimates, not direct camera readings. Images are illustrations.

yeh sabse zaroori context hai.

47-parameter design: BP, SpO₂ aur temperature ka status

Blood pressure, oxygen saturation aur temperature research scope mein hain. Inki measurement aur learning mein usefulness ko alag se validate karna hoga.

  • Blood pressure: Circulation ka parameter hai. Camera-based estimate aur learning-state interpretation, dono ko independent validation chahiye.
  • SpO₂: Blood oxygen saturation ko estimate karta hai. Yeh samajh ya confusion ka direct score nahi hai; Into3 ke camera setup par accuracy aur usefulness establish honi baaki hai.
  • Temperature: Measurement method abhi confirmed nahi hai. Ordinary RGB camera ko thermometer ke roop mein present nahi kiya ja raha.
  • Variability: Camera-derived pulse-rate variability (PRV) automatically clinical heart-rate variability (HRV) ke barabar nahi hoti.

Complete 47-parameter coverage launch ke liye abhi verified nahi hai.

Is approach ke peeche science kya hai?

Multimodal research physiological signals, facial behaviour, task observations aur learner feedback ko saath study karti hai. Ek 2025 classroom study ne individual baselines use kiye, lekin uska detailed analysis sirf teen adult learners par tha. Yeh approach ki research relevance dikhata hai; Into3 ya school-age bachchon ke liye accuracy prove nahi karta. Read the classroom study.

Camera pulse research lighting, movement aur population-related errors ko examine karti hai. Read the rPPG study. Temperature research mein thermal camera use hua tha, sirf RGB webcam nahi. Read the temperature study.

Into3 ko apne supported devices aur target age groups par sensor accuracy, state interpretation aur actual learning benefit test karne honge. Zyada signals ka matlab automatically zyada accuracy nahi hai.

Personal baseline, consent aur bachche ka control

Relevant history aur permission milne par personal baseline banega. Pehli visit ya kam history mein understanding limited rahegi. Camera aur microphone optional, purpose-specific consent par use honge; core learning inke bina bhi available rahegi. Bachcha feedback dekar interpretation correct kar sakega. Estimates temporary aur uncertain honge—permanent personality labels ya medical diagnosis nahi.

RTAE aur Personal Planner ka kaam kaise alag hai?

RTAE current learning state aur usmein badlav samajhne ke liye available evidence ko analyse karega. Individual Learning Planner (ILP) us understanding ko bachche ke learning goals aur history ke saath jodkar plan coordinate karega. Teacher, Practice aur Revision agents padhayenge aur samajh check karenge. Ek expression ya pulse reading se exact stress ya samajh establish nahi hoti.

When will my child get access?

Launch is planned for December 2026–January 2027. The introductory month starts when your child’s access is activated. Paying ₹100 now reserves access; it does not unlock learning immediately.

What does my ₹100 payment reserve?

It reserves founding-family access under the published offer. If you continue after the introductory month, your ₹100 is credited to the first paid bill. It is an advance payment, not an additional discount.

What is exclusive to founding families?

The six-month discount: ₹100 off each of the first six paid months, saving ₹600 in total. The included introductory month is the standard introductory month, not an extra founding-family month.

What will I pay after the introductory month?

If you choose to continue, your first paid bill is ₹1,299 after the ₹100 reservation credit. The next five paid bills are ₹1,399 each. After those six paid months, the planned price is ₹1,499/month. There is no automatic subscription debit.

Are all the features shown available today?

Into3 is in pre-launch. The examples show the planned experience. Features, activity catalogues and supported devices for the founding cohort will be confirmed. Full 47-parameter RTAE coverage is not yet verified for launch.

Do I need PRIA Dock? Is it included in ₹100?

The demonstrated handwritten-practice flow uses PRIA Dock. Compatible setups will be confirmed for launch. The Dock is designed to give the Practice Agent a real-time view of the steps your child writes in their notebook. The agent can check the working, offer a hint or explanation at a difficult step, and check the next attempt. Recognition depends on a supported setup and clearly visible handwriting. The ₹100 payment reserves founding-family access; the published subscription offer does not specify hardware inclusion. Dock availability, compatibility and any separate price must be confirmed before purchase.

Can the camera tell exact stress or understanding?

An expression, posture or pulse reading alone cannot establish what a child understands or their exact stress level. The intended design combines available signals with written work, answers and the child’s feedback. Camera observations, physiological estimates and device measurements are different sources. RTAE does not read thoughts or establish medical diagnoses.

Can I cancel? What if launch is delayed?

You can cancel before the launch deadline for a full ₹100 refund. If Into3 has not launched by 31 January 2027, the ₹100 reservation is fully refundable. Eligible refunds are manually initiated within 24 hours; bank or payment-provider settlement may take additional time. See the reservation-specific terms.

When does this founding offer close?

This founding-offer window closes on 2 November 2026 at 10:31 pm IST. Reservations made during the offer window keep their agreed founding-family terms.
